contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with and complementary to corroborated FND-0031 (pure m=0 / depth-one Gysin corner reduces to THM-0003), FND-0032 (undecorated CGP top-weight is the wrong corner), and FND-0033 (pure-row semisimplicity), and with mechanically verified FND-0001 / RED-0001. Independent primary checks. (1) Non-separating clutching: SRC-0003 (CLP, arXiv:2209.03113v2) states that each component of the normalization of the boundary is a finite quotient of Mbar_{g-1,n+2} or a product Mbar_{g1,n1+1}×Mbar_{g2,n2+1}; the one-edge loop case is explicitly identified as Mbar_{g-1,n+2} with Aut=S_2 (swap of the two half-edges at the node). Standard moduli geometry (Knudsen clutching / dual-graph stratification; e.g. Schmitt ModCurves notes) confirms the gluing map ξ_irr: Mbar_{g-1,n+2}→Mbar_{g,n} has image the irreducible non-separating boundary divisor. For (g,n)=(6,6) this is Mbar_{5,8}, not Mbar_{5,7}: genus drops by one and the normalization gains two legs at the node, n+2=8. (2) Dimension: d=3g-3+n gives dim Mbar_{6,6}=21 and dim Mbar_{5,8}=3·5-3+8=20=21-1 (codimension one), while dim Mbar_{5,7}=19 is not codimension one—so the ATT-0014 labelling Mbar_{5,7} is arithmetically and geometrically false. (3) Depth-one Gysin sources into H^{26}(Mbar_{6,6}): by FND-0031 / THM-0003 / SRC-0002 right-exact sequence H^{k-2}(~∂)→H^k(Mbar)→W_k H^k(M)→0 at k=26, only codim-1 strata contribute; those strata are the non-separating component (normalization Mbar_{5,8}/S_2) and separating products Mbar_{i,a+1}×Mbar_{6-i,b+1} (a+b=6). Thus the only non-product / non-separating Gysin source is Mbar_{5,8}. (4) RED-0001 residual list explicitly includes both (6,6) and (5,8), so any depth-one attack on (6,6) couples directly to the unresolved (5,8) input rather than to strictly simpler discharged base cases. (5) Edge decoration: SRC-0003 records the weight-complex / Getzler–Kapranov E_1 terms as ⊕_{|E(Γ)|=j}(H^k(Mbar_Γ)⊗det E(Γ))^{Aut(Γ)}, with det E(Γ) the determinant of the Aut-permutation representation on edges; for the non-separating loop the S_2-action swapping the two branches (equivalently the two half-edges) acts by the sign on det E_Γ, so Aut-invariants with the det twist kill odd-edge-permutation contributions omitted by ATT-0014. Mild precision note only: the geometric normalization of the divisor is the quotient Mbar_{5,8}/S_2 rather than the raw stack Mbar_{5,8}, which the finding already accounts for via the Aut/det decoration. Distinct from FND-0031 (which strata depths contribute), FND-0032 (CGP corner mismatch), and FND-0033 (semisimplicity): do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from legacy_artifact to primary_source on independent primary-source verification of the non-separating clutching identification Mbar_{5,8}, the codimension arithmetic, the RED-0001 coupling, and the det-E Aut E_1 decoration.
